privacy: Generated symbolic notes only. No live project, MIDI file, or audio was sent.

response.explanation: This representation is a complete exact JSON note corpus with reconstructed notes, multi-bar structure, and patch-based transformations.
Compact-bar encodes absolute bar and note times with rational-beat positions, roles, and harmony for precise editing.
ABC is a compact human-readable score notation that encodes notes, timing, and harmony in text.
This is a text-based sequencer representation that encodes grouped notes by part plus exact counted note events.
This representation is an autoregressive token stream that encodes musical events as note-on, note-off, and time-shift tokens with task extensions for structure and harmony.
A bar-aware token stream encodes absolute bar starts plus per-note bar-relative positions, pitches, velocities, and durations for symbolic music generation.
This representation encodes compound musical events with exact rational timing, per-note track metadata, and bar-level meter, tempo, and harmony context.
